sources: Following acquisitions of Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, and the transformative addition of Resulticks, Diginex is evolving from point solutions into a fully integrated end-to-end platform spanning carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain transparency, human rights due diligence, and now AI-driven customer data capabilities — designed to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.

The Resulticks acquisition is the pivotal move — adding proprietary AI-driven customer data capabilities to a compliance/ESG core transforms the product from a reporting tool into a strategic business intelligence platform.
Diginex has now absorbed four distinct businesses (Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, Resulticks) across multiple jurisdictions — a complex undertaking.

prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: four paper building shapes; string and pins.
Opens on the document, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips away as the document folds into four small paper buildings; string and pins link them together.
Ends holding on the linked buildings.
This composition is a diagram: several elements are arranged together.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "4 ACQUISITIONS".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "4 ACQUISITIONS". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage style, presented as a high-angle Static Shot photographed flat under soft, natural room lighting from the upper left. <Picture 1> opens the scene with a purple paper ground, a cream paper chip with the text "ESG REPORTING" in bold black sans-serif, and a halftone photographic document cutout with rough white torn edges resting on grid paper. Immediately upon onset, the purple background is covered by a single, unbroken flat block of pale cyan paper. Simultaneously, the "ESG REPORTING" chip flips away rapidly with a slight overshoot, disappearing from the frame. The central halftone document cutout begins to fold and crease dynamically, transforming into four distinct black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of building shapes. These building cutouts possess rough white torn edges and cast small, soft shadows onto the pale cyan ground. As the buildings settle into a diagrammatic arrangement in the lower two-thirds of the frame, cream-colored paper ribbons of string and small black pins materialize, linking the four buildings together in a network. In the upper third of the frame, a new cream-colored paper chip lands with a fast, snappy motion, featuring the clean, legible, and stable black text "4 ACQUISITIONS" in an extra-bold sans-serif font. The composition holds this final diagram for the remaining duration, with the elements exhibiting a subtle, rhythmic pulsing loop.

overall_soundscape: The audio consists of crisp, tactile foley sounds. A sharp paper-slap occurs as the first chip flips away, followed by the rhythmic, textured crinkling and folding sounds of heavy paper. Small, distinct clicking sounds accompany the placement of the pins, and a final, soft thud marks the landing of the "4 ACQUISITIONS" chip.
